menu.method: pair gate (M1 task-4 candidate table: the pair SAT gap must be able to reach 0 on box(z-hat,R)) INTERSECTED with a per-selection gate: every one of the 4 rows of the (owner,edge,corner) selection must be able to be >= 0 on the box and its SEP row must be able to reach 0, both via the [IV] mean-value enclosure  row(z-hat) +/- ||grad||_{1,box}*R. sep = 0 with dom >= 0 forces the pair to touch, so the pair gate is legitimate.

task2_farkas_radius.method: y from the max-margin LP at z-hat (|y| <= 50, y[33] = -1, so e_s . y = -1 < 0), rationalised at denominator 1e9.  For each r the [IV] lower bound of grad g . y over box(z-hat, r) must be > 0 for EVERY row y has to beat.  Rigorous per (set, r): lambda >= 0 with A^T lambda = e_s would give 0 > e_s.y = sum lambda_k (grad g_k . y) >= 0.

modes.none: retained rows only (M1-style kill, ignores gained contacts)
modes.fixed: retained + the whole R=0.05 gained menu at every radius
modes.matched: retained + menu(r): the rows that can actually be active on box(z-hat,r).  This is the self-consistent certificate and is the headline number.

task3_cascade_radius.rule: For every square i and coordinate c in {cx_i, cy_i, theta_i}, FJ stationarity gives sum_k lambda_k A[k,c] = 0 with lambda >= 0 (grad s touches only z[33], so this holds in BOTH the lambda_0 > 0 and lambda_0 = 0 branches).  INTERVAL FORM on box(z-hat,r): if every retained row has A_box[k,c] >= 0 (or every one <= 0), then every row with a strictly signed interval has lambda_k = 0 on the WHOLE box.  Rows whose interval contains 0 are neither killed nor blocking.  Structurally absent entries are exactly 0.  Iterated to a fixed point.  [IV], sound on the box.

escaping_class.definition: cone-dead WITHOUT the gained menu, cone-ALIVE with it, not empty, not killed by the force-balance cascade (gained rows in the row set), and not covered by the D2/slack layer.  Exactly the strata M1 truncated away wrongly.
